title: Daddy's on Dialysis
author: Patrick Abernathy
audience: Children with a Parent on Dialysis & Families
mlbSummary: A child-focused story created to help families begin conversations about a parent's dialysis treatment. It validates that children may feel scared, strong, confused, or curious and encourages them to ask questions about what dialysis means for their family.

title: Sydney's Kidney Adventure: Her Big Wish for Mom Comes True!
author: Risa Simon
audience: Children with a Loved One Awaiting Kidney Transplant
mlbSummary: Sydney learns that her mother needs a kidney transplant and sets out on a hopeful search for a living donor. The story gives families a child-friendly way to talk about kidney failure, living donation, transplant waiting, and how children can process a loved one's medical journey.

author: Nadine Morsi

title: Peanuts for Penny
author: Linda McCain
mlbSummary: Three eight-year-old friends face the news that Penny needs a kidney transplant. Her friends try to find a meaningful way to help, giving young readers a story about transplant, friendship, community support, and feeling less powerless when someone they care about is sick.
